raw.details:
About the Event

Most hackathons stop at "it works." Prompts to Profits, presented by Master’s Union, starts there.

Prompts to Profits is an intensive three-round business-building hackathon where participants learn to build scalable startup ventures around interactive media, gamified experiences, and game products. No prior coding experience is required!

In today’s tech landscape, game development isn't just about code-it's a multi-billion dollar business driven by user retention, monetization models, and market strategy. Using AI-powered vibe coding tools, teams will build rapid prototypes (including gamified software and interactive products) while focusing on the core business challenge: finding product-market fit, establishing unit economics, and pitching to investors.

At Prompts to Profits, you will experience the complete startup journey inside a simulated virtual marketplace. Armed with virtual investment capital, teams will pitch their ventures, evaluate competitor business models, and bid on the most promising startups-putting their business strategy, product thinking, and market sense to the ultimate test.

Event Details

  • Date: 1 November 2026

  • Venue: AB 10/103, IIT Gandhinagar

  • Mode: Offline for Round 1

  • Team Size: 3 members

  • Eligibility: College students

  • Registration Fee: Free

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹3,00,000 across all three rounds

Participants without a complete team can register individually or in smaller groups and form teams of three with other participants at the venue.

Opening Session: Fireside Chat with Dharmil Bavishi

The event begins with an insightful fireside chat with Dharmil Bavishi, Co-founder of Bullspree, a gamified stock market learning platform that secured funding on Shark Tank India.

Hear a real founder's perspective on using gaming elements to disrupt traditional industries, building scalable revenue streams, securing venture funding, and growing a business from scratch.

How It Works

Prompts to Profits consists of three progressive rounds:

Round 1: In-Person Business Hackathon at IIT Gandhinagar

Teams of three will use AI-powered vibe coding to prototype an interactive or gamified product and build a comprehensive business case around it. Once submitted, teams step into the shoes of venture capitalists-using virtual capital to evaluate, negotiate, and invest in other teams' business ideas.

The complete rules and evaluation rubric will be revealed at the venue.

Round 2: Online Strategy & Venture Round

Selected teams from Round 1 advance to the online round, where they refine their business models, user acquisition strategies, and financial projections to compete for a spot in the grand finale.

Round 3: Grand Finale at Master’s Union Campus, Gurgaon

  • Qualified finalist teams present their venture pitches live to investors and industry leaders at Master’s Union, Gurgaon.

  • Teams qualifying for Round 3 will receive fully sponsored flights to Gurgaon.

Event Schedule – 1 November 2026

  • 11:30 AM – 1:00 PM: Fireside Chat with Dharmil Bavishi

  • 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM: Lunch (provided outside the venue by organizers)

  • 2:00 PM onwards: Business Building & Pitch Hackathon

What Will You Gain?

  • Master Venture Creation: Learn how to turn interactive product ideas into viable businesses with sustainable revenue models and clear go-to-market strategies.

  • Build with AI (Vibe Coding): Experience how modern founders quickly prototype gamified applications and digital products using AI, even without prior coding experience.

  • Understand Market & Gaming Dynamics: Analyze how engagement mechanics translate into monetization, and practice evaluating startup valuations using virtual investment capital.

  • Learn from a Shark Tank Founder: Get firsthand insights on leveraging gamification for business growth and securing venture capital.

  • Compete for Big Rewards: Advance through three strategic rounds for a chance to win from a ₹3,00,000 prize pool.

  • Reach the Grand Finale: Qualified teams earn fully sponsored flights to pitch their startups at Master’s Union in Gurgaon.

Perks and Benefits

  • Free registration

  • Lunch and refreshments provided during the hackathon

  • Exclusive goodies and hampers

  • Fully sponsored flights to Gurgaon for Round 3 finalists

  • Direct networking with startup founders and business mentors

  • A chance to compete for a total prize pool of ₹3 Lakhs

What to Bring

  • At least one fully charged laptop with its charger per team

  • One smartphone per team member

  • A Google account for each team member

Who Should Participate?

Prompts to Profits is ideal for students interested in entrepreneurship, business strategy, product management, gaming business models, and AI innovation. Whether you want to launch a startup, explore how games monetize, or build business models using AI, this hackathon gives you the platform to bring your ideas to life.

Bring your sharpest business thinking, build a compelling venture, and convince the market that your product deserves backing!

Register now for Prompts to Profits and turn your prompts into profits.
